node.title: E22 fixed-scale staircase injectivity
node.statement: For a fixed quotient modulus M, the locator L_B(X)G(X^M) of a tail |B|<M plus full quotient fibers determines the selected fibers and the tail uniquely. Equivalently, there are no hidden multiplicities inside one fixed M staircase scale.
node.attack_surface: unique factorization/root-set recovery at fixed M
node.falsifier: two distinct tails or selected quotient-fiber sets at the same M with the same locator
